references.text: The eye shall not pity the enemy - same principle of showing no mercy when God's judgment is executed
The eye shall not spare the one who leads others to idolatry - same expression about showing no compassion
Direct context repeating the principle that the eye must not show pity
Purging innocent blood from Israel - same expression 'to purge innocent blood from Israel'
Bloodguilt defiles the land and must be cleansed - the basis for laws concerning the removal of innocent blood
Removal of evil from Israel - same principle of cleansing the community
Removal of evil from Israel through capital punishment for rebellion against a judge
The eye shall not spare - same exhortation to carry out the penalty without mercy
